item.title: Ren'ai, Hajimemashite
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ASa Project
  • 発売日: 2025-02-28
  • スコア: 7.2299999999999995/10 (159 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋愛、はじめまして
  • 英語名: Ren’ai, Hajimemashite

别名

  • 恋はじ

あらすじ

I always thought my student life would pass by without much to remember.

Getting to class early for no real reason, half-listening to the teacher with my mind elsewhere, longing for the bell to ring so I could go home without saying a word to anyone. Sometimes, I’d wish for something—anything—to break up the monotony, but deep down, I figured my youth had already slipped away.

あらすじ

Due to declining birth rates and other adult concerns, the protagonist Kanata and his friends find themselves transferring to Ouka Academy, a renowned all-girls school that’s newly going co-ed.

The boys, driven by the simple desire for girlfriends, eagerly anticipate their new life among the supposedly prim and proper young ladies.

However, on the first day of co-education, reality hits hard.

あらすじ

Talk about waking up on the wrong side of the bed! Our hero, Koga Nao, finds himself in a classic “morning after” scenario with a girl he barely knows.

“You’re gonna own up to this… so… you’d better date me, got it?” demands Toiro Kirame, the girl he met at a mixer. Koga’s pretty sure he was just playing Good Samaritan, but she’s convinced they hooked up, and before he knows it, he’s being strong-armed into “taking responsibility.”

item.title: Ren'ai, Karichaimashita
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ASa Project
  • 発売日: 2019-07-26
  • スコア: 7.25/10 (2396 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋愛、借りちゃいました
  • 英語名: Ren’ai, Karichaimashita

别名

  • こいかり

あらすじ

Because of his family’s unique circumstances, the only thing Yuki put his faith in was that “Money will make my little sister happy.” To this end, he regularly worked a part-time job until late at night.

His goals were to graduate as soon as possible and get a full-time job. But, one day as he was leaving for work, his little sister told him, “If Yuki isn’t going to college then I won’t either.” He knew he couldn’t put such a burden upon his little sister.

  • 日本語名: かりぐらし恋愛
  • 英語名: Karigurashi Ren’ai

あらすじ

Takuma had many fond memories of the town where he used to live as a child and he wished to return there one day. He worked hard to pass the entrance exam for the only school in the town and successfully achieved his long-cherished dream!

He moved back to the town for a new start, planning on living by himself in his childhood home, but it was in such a dilapidated state that it was essentially uninhabitable. Without the money to look for a temporary residence, Takuma was at a loss as to what to do.

item.title: Puramai Wars
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ASa Project
  • 発売日: 2015-04-24
  • スコア: 7.38/10 (235 人評価)
  • 日本語名: プラマイウォーズ
  • 英語名: Puramai Wars

あらすじ

“Modesty, fairness and grace”: That’s the motto by which Chihaya and his sisters Kyouko and Mei were brought up with by their strict father. Their family was well-respected in the neighbourhood; You could say they’re the ideal family. Due to an unexpected event, they ended up sharing a house with the family of one of their parents’ co-workers. Chihaya heard that there were three beautiful sisters and was looking forward to living together with them, but it turns out that their nature is totally opposite of their family!

item.title: Ren'ai 0 Kilometer
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ASa Project
  • 発売日: 2011-10-28
  • スコア: 7.01/10 (349 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋愛0キロメートル
  • 英語名: Ren’ai 0 Kilometer

别名

  • Zerokiro

あらすじ

A reckless mother with 5 daughters lived next door to a reckless father with 4 sons. The daughters wished for a boy in the family, while the sons wanted a girl. So their parents proposed that they swap one child between the two families for 3 months. Kyouichi, the second-oldest son, was selected and the girls, who were only osananajimis before, now treated him like their own otouto or onii-chan. The girl who was swapped out also had feelings for him and was extremely jealous that she cannot be part of the family as well. He felt both happy and very uneasy… how will this pretend-family turn out?

item.title: Acchi Muite Koi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ASa Project
  • 発売日: 2010-04-30
  • スコア: 7.12/10 (113 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アッチむいて恋
  • 英語名: Acchi Muite Koi

あらすじ

Kousuke just transferred into rural Harusaki Gakuen, but the school accidentally didn’t reserve a room for him. After much searching he found a free room, but it’s at a girls’ dorm! Thus begins his double life: as a boy at school and as a girl named Mae in the dorm. A pretty common scenario, and one in which his cover is bound to be blown eventually. However, he has his imouto Runa on his side, who followed him to the dorm so that no other girl can take her oniichan away. Also, the most ojousama-like chara in the school is actually a trap.

item.title: Meikuru! Welcome to Happy Maid Life!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ASa Project
  • 発売日: 2007-05-25
  • スコア: 6.459999999999999/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: めいくるッ！ Welcome to Happy Maid Life!!
  • 英語名: Meikuru! Welcome to Happy Maid Life!!

别名

  • めいくるッ！ ～Welcome to Happy Maid Life!!～

あらすじ

The protagonist is an ordinary student, enjoying his school life with his friends and classmates. One day, his homeroom teacher tells them, “We are having a training student from Japan Maid Academy.” Maid? Academy? They don’t know what’s going on. On the next day, the maid comes to his school, and they panicked. This is a slapstick school maid adventure game.
